reason: Spearman's correction for attenuation is derived for the product-moment correlation under classical test theory; Cohen's kappa is chance-corrected and marginal-dependent and meets neither condition. The two inputs also came from different populations with different prevalence. The corrected values are not reported in any manuscript version from v4 onward.

withdrawn_content.description: Criterion-level kappa corrected for the rater-level floor
withdrawn_content.caveat: Derived for product-moment correlations between continuous measures. Applied to kappa it is an approximation sensitive to prevalence and to the marginal distributions.
